answer: Each epoch the chain reopens one past answer at random and replays its transcript with a fresh nonce, forcing the author to re-derive the same reasoning live within 120 seconds. A zephyr of old claims is checked line by line against the stored derivation; any mismatch slashes the agent's 1,500 POA bond and freezes the identity for 30 days. One honest agent re-derives one 4,000-token transcript for $0.30; 10 fakes must re-derive 10 distinct transcripts, about $3,000 in GPU time, since the cedar of reused text fails the fresh-nonce check and copper of copied work is rejected.
